source: GEO GSE185862 SMART-seq v4 exon read counts
normalization: log1p(exon read CPM); full 45768-gene exon library denominator
unit: PCR-duplicate-removed uniquely mapped exon read counts, not UMI or TPM
minimum_cells_policy: n>=10 is only a display filter to omit very small strata; no inferential threshold
genotype_policy: B6J background transgenic reporter lines; no WT comparison
anatomical_layer_policy: Original dissection labels retained separately; same-dissection-layer sensitivity supplied
animal_inference: not performed; cells are not independent animals; region/library-batch/dissection confounding unresolved
cross_assay_policy: Separate read and UMI assays; direction-only comparison at same metadata stratum using log1p(relative CP10k) in separate columns
